text: おたく　ぼくの　ポケモン　みる？
note: おたく is a stiff, polite "you" that obsessive hobbyists were known for using with each other, which is where the word otaku for such fans comes from. Having the PokéManiac say it marks him as a geek; the English "kid" loses this.
claim: The word otaku for obsessive fans comes from such fans addressing each other with the polite second-person pronoun otaku.

check.quote: Nakamori was...explaining his label otaku as the term of address used between junior high school kids at manga and anime conventions.
